_comment: Fictional JDM performance wheel & tire catalog for the ACME Wheels storefront. Every brand and figure below is invented. Variant compact rows are filled in from the family per demo_common.storefront_fixtures.load_catalog; option_values are diameter/width/offset/finish for wheels and size for tires. bolt_pattern, center_bore_mm, and lead_time_days live in each variant's attributes so search and get_disclosure can surface fitment facts without a separate lookup. Landed cost and supplier are intentionally NOT here: they live in data/unit_economics.json, which no StorefrontBackend method the shopping agent can reach ever reads from.

products.title: Kaiten SF-01 Flow-Formed Wheel

attributes.fits: Nissan Silvia S13/S14/S15, Skyline R32 GT-R, Subaru WRX/STI 2015-2021 (5x114.3)

products.short_description: A 6-spoke flow-formed wheel in a classic JDM concave profile. Sold individually; most customers order a matching set of 4.
products.long_description: The SF-01 is flow-formed from a single billet for a lighter rim than a cast wheel at a similar price, with a deep concave face that keeps the classic 90s JDM look. Offered in a flush non-staggered setup or a staggered set (narrower front, wider rear) for cars that support it. Every unit ships boxed in pairs to reduce transit damage.

products.title: Raion GT-3 Forged Three-Piece Wheel

attributes.fits: Nissan Silvia S13/S14/S15, Skyline R32/R33 GT-R, Subaru WRX/STI 2015-2021 (5x114.3)

products.short_description: A forged three-piece wheel with a deep-dish barrel for a wide, flush stance. Sold individually.
products.long_description: The GT-3 is forged rather than cast, so it carries less unsprung weight than the SF-01 at a given width, and the bolted barrel lets a shop rebuild it after curb damage instead of replacing the whole wheel. Built to order; longer lead time than the flow-formed line.

specs.rebuildable: Barrel and face sold separately for width changes or curb repair

attributes.pairs_with: The rear half of the staggered set with wheel-raion-gt3-18x95-12-satinblack up front

products.title: Meisho RPF-Style Lightweight Track Wheel
products.short_description: A lightweight mesh track wheel with the direct 56.1mm bore Subaru/Toyota cars use from the factory.
products.long_description: The RPF-style wheel is a long-running favorite for autocross and track cars on the 5x100 platform: light enough to notice in rotating mass, and its 56.1mm center bore is a direct fit on 86/BRZ hubs with no hub-centric ring needed, unlike most of this catalog's 73.1mm wheels.

attributes.hub_ring_required: No; 56.1mm is a direct fit on Subaru/Toyota 86 platform hubs
No; 56.1mm is a direct fit on Subaru/Toyota 86 platform hubs

products.title: Hachiroku Classic Retro Mesh Wheel
products.short_description: A period-correct 8-spoke mesh wheel sized for AE86 and NA/NB Miata builds.
products.long_description: Smaller and lighter than the rest of this catalog, matching the fender clearance and factory look of 80s-90s lightweight coupes rather than modern staggered fitment. A budget-friendly way into a full set of four.

attributes.hub_ring_required: No for AE86; yes (54.1->56.1) for early NA Miata
No for AE86; yes (54.1->56.1) for early NA Miata

products.title: Raiden PS-01 Ultra-High-Performance Summer Tire
products.short_description: A DOT-approved street UHP tire; sold and priced individually.
products.long_description: The everyday street tire in this catalog: DOT-approved, quiet enough to daily, and stocked in the sizes the wheels above are built around so a set of four can ship alongside a wheel order in the same box.

products.title: Kumo TR-Z Drift Compound Tire

attributes.fits: Common on Nissan Silvia S-chassis, Toyota AE86, Mazda Miata drift builds

products.short_description: A hard, low-grip semi-slick compound built for controlled drifting, not street use.
products.long_description: Not DOT-approved: several states treat a tire without a DOT code as unfit for road use, so plan on trailering or a closed track/drift day for this one. Wears fast at track pace by design; buyers usually keep a spare set on hand.

products.title: Genroku R8 Heritage Eight-Spoke Wheel

attributes.fits: Nissan Skyline Hakosuka/Kenmeri, classic Datsun/Nissan 4x114.3 platforms

products.short_description: A period-correct thin-spoke eight-spoke wheel for 1960s-70s Nissan classics. Sold individually.
products.long_description: The R8 keeps the low-offset, thin-spoke look that defined Japanese racing wheels in period, cast from a magnesium alloy for a lighter feel than the modern-platform wheels in this catalog. It is sized for the classics it is built for, not for 2000s-2020s JDM platforms — check fitment before ordering a set for anything newer than a Kenmeri.

attributes.hub_ring_required: No; 66.1mm is the direct hub size on Hakosuka/Kenmeri-era Nissans

products.title: Kessho Forged Monoblock Wheel

attributes.fits: Nissan Silvia S13/S14/S15, Skyline R32 GT-R, Subaru WRX/STI 2015-2021 (5x114.3)

products.short_description: A single-piece forged wheel, lighter than this catalog's bolted three-piece line at a similar width. Sold individually.
products.long_description: Forging one piece rather than bolting a barrel to a face saves the weight of the hardware, so the monoblock is the lightest wheel in this catalog at a given width — the trade-off against the Raion GT-3 is that a monoblock can't be rebuilt after curb damage or re-barreled for a width change; the whole wheel is replaced instead.

attributes.pairs_with: The rear half of the staggered set with wheel-kessho-monoblock-18x95-38-gunmetal up front

products.title: Hayate RT-X Trackday Tire
products.short_description: DOT-approved but built for lap times, not commuting; sold and priced individually.
products.long_description: The step up from the Raiden when a car sees the track more than the street: a much softer compound and lower treadwear rating trade everyday mileage and quiet ride for cornering grip. Street-legal, but wears fast at street use and louder than a summer tire.
